text: Digoxin acts as a selective inhibitor of the Na+/K+-ATPase (ATP1A1) pump by binding to the extracellular domain of the alpha subunit. This inhibition increases intracellular sodium concentrations, which subsequently reduces the activity of the sodium-calcium exchanger (NCX), leading to elevated intracellular calcium levels and enhanced myocardial contractility (positive inotropy) in heart failure patients.
